content.title: Wells Fargo Stocks Pops To Record High; Analysts See Strong Growth Ahead
content.summary: Also on Wednesday, the IBD Relative Strength Rating for Wells Fargo stock rose to 75, up from 69 the day before.  The upgraded 75 RS Rating shows that San Francisco-based Wells Fargo's stock tops 75% of all stocks for price performance over the last 52 weeks.  Decades of market research reveals that the top-performing stocks typically have an 80 or better RS Rating as they begin their largest climbs.
